en.headline: Your sugar tablet
body: Your sugar tablet is called metformin.
It helps your body use sugar better.
Take it with a meal or just after.
An upset stomach at first is common.
en.passage: Take it with or just after meals to reduce stomach upset.

ms.headline: Ubat gula anda
body: Ubat ini membantu badan anda guna gula dengan lebih baik.
Ambil semasa makan atau sejurus selepas makan.
Perut rasa tidak selesa pada mulanya adalah biasa.
ms.passage: Take it with or just after meals to reduce stomach upset.

zh.headline: 您的降糖药
body: 您的降糖药叫二甲双胍。
它帮身体更好地用掉糖。
刚开始时胃不舒服很常见。
zh.passage: Take it with or just after meals to reduce stomach upset.
